trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment ran without evidence of a fresh local Tailscale probe in the current invocation (the caller did not pass a populated `fresh_probe_invocations` count). Materialization requires fresh probe evidence to avoid acting on stale autodiscovery state; the auto-enrollment outcome surfaces this code so the caller knows their probe pipeline is the gap, not the discovery itself.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # without first running the SRR6.46.1 probe end-to-end
